facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (decree 26-003/PR of 16 January 2026) appropriates KMF 50 000 000, wholly as a transfer, to the chambre du Numérique (service 09 0910, under the digital ministry).

The line fell from KMF 73 000 000 in the 2025 rectificative law to KMF 50 000 000 in the 2026 law (budget years 2025 and 2026), minus 31.5%; the document notes this and another body's line look swapped between the years and cannot tell a real cut from a transcription swap.

systems.owner: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique
